topic: using an experiment to change product direction

legacyPrompt: For Meta, as a QA / Test Engineer: Give a specific example of using using an experiment to change product direction to resolve disagreement or uncertainty. Account for social-graph scale, rapid experimentation, integrity, and real-time interaction. Use risk-based coverage, deterministic test oracles, environment control, and defect isolation. Frame the example around this constraint: Evaluate noisy telemetry that hides a slowly growing failure rate; demonstrate correctness under replay and repeated execution; assume success must remain measurable for one quarter after launch. Separate your own decision and measurable result; address direction, matrix, experiment, failures, materially, objection, imperfect, credible, causally.
expectedAnswerSummary: Anchor the story in one QA / Test Engineer situation with dates or sequence, constraints, affected users or teams, and why using an experiment to change product direction mattered.
